name: Motorsport Corner Masterclass — Telemetry & Racing Line

generation.continuity: clip N>1 uses the last frame of clip N-1 as its initial frame (flow.sh video --from)
generation.join: flow.sh join (ffmpeg concat of the Flow clips; no external audio)
generation.narration: spoken by Flow inside the clip; never external TTS

blocks.style: Photorealistic 3D CGI, cinematic broadcast motorsport analysis style, one continuous camera move with no cuts.

clip_templates.prompt: {style} {vehicle} races toward a generic unnamed {corner_type} at {approach_speed}, captured in a dynamic drone chase shot. A glowing neon racing line illuminates the asphalt track ahead, with braking-point marker boards rendered as plain blank geometric rectangular foam boards without text or numbers. Carbon-ceramic brake discs glow bright cherry red under heavy deceleration while the driver initiates turn-in. No official league, series or governing-body logos (no F1, FIA, MotoGP, FIM or Dorna logos), no sponsor logos, no watermarks. {audio} {narrator} "{narration_1}"

Continue seamlessly from this exact frame, same cinematic broadcast motorsport analysis style, same {vehicle_short}, no sponsor logos, no numbers, one continuous camera move with no cuts. The camera swings low into the geometric apex of the {corner_type}, displaying glowing blue lateral force vectors and glowing yellow speed arrows across the chassis. Extreme macro close-up captures tyre sidewall deformation gripping the red-and-white rumble kerb before the car unleashes full traction and accelerates onto the exit straight. {audio} {narrator_followup} "{narration_2}"

keywords_that_worked: Drone chase shot follows ... glowing neon racing line illuminates the asphalt
braking-point marker boards rendered as plain blank geometric rectangular foam boards without text
Carbon-ceramic brake discs glow bright cherry red
Continue seamlessly from this exact frame
one continuous camera move with no cuts
glowing blue lateral force vectors and glowing yellow speed arrows
tyre sidewall deformation gripping the rumble kerb
no sponsor logos, no numbers, no official league, series or governing-body logos (no F1, FIA, MotoGP, FIM or Dorna logos)
rules: Corners must be generic technical corner types (hairpin, chicane, banked sweeper, compression complex) - never name real circuits, curves, or track complexes.
Braking boards must be plain blank shapes without text, digits, or logos.
Never display F1, FIA, or MotoGP logos, wordmarks, or sponsor decals.
Narration must be strictly in English, exactly 22-24 words per clip.
Clip 2 must begin with 'Continue seamlessly from this exact frame' and maintain a single continuous camera move without cuts.
topic_ideas: heavy braking downhill hairpin with acute turn-in and late apex line
high-speed off-camber chicane balancing rapid directional weight transfer
steeply banked bowl sweeper generating massive sustained lateral g-forces
blind uphill crest compression loading suspension at terminal velocity
double apex carousel requiring trail-braking and delicate throttle feathering
tight decreasing-radius sweeper punishing front-tyre thermal degradation
flat-out uphill esses demanding aerodynamic commitment and kerb clipping
high-speed friction chicane testing rapid damper rebound and floor clearance
ninety-degree street corner with zero margin against concrete barrier perimeter
reverse-camber switchback where rear traction limits exit acceleration

variables.approach_speed: over three hundred kilometres per hour
variables.narration_1: Approaching a heavy braking hairpin, the driver stomps the pedal with over one hundred kilograms of force, scrubbing speed in hundred metres.
variables.narration_2: At the apex, lateral force reaches five Gs as tyres deform over the kerb before full throttle propels the car forward.
